criteria: A paper is relevant if it directly studies the question's intervention/exposure in the question's population or topic AND reports results (primary study, systematic review/meta-analysis, or evidence summary). Protocols, editorials, methods/measurement papers, and papers on a different condition or intervention are not relevant. Judged only within the retrieved pool, by reading title and abstract of the unranked list. This is one reviewer's judgment: please review.
